utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Can you hear me, or am I doing the silent Teams presentation again?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, you're there. Bit tinny, but that's probably this headset.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Better than the broken coffee machine in the canteen. It's just dispensing disappointment now.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: So no change in flavour, then.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: At least the disappointment used to be hot. Anyway, that's a moan, not a maintenance request.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I was going to ask about weekend plans, but the weather looks rubbish again. My grand outdoor plans might be the sofa.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Very sensible. Waterproof sofa, ideally.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, Tuesday the twelfth. Let's do the closed stuff first so we don't accidentally give it out again.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, so, tested the big boiler yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished, not another test going on today's list.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, understood. Good to have that one off the board.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I've signed off the inspection on the stretch wrapper on Tuesday — this morning, I mean. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Lovely. Both closed.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I already swapped the filter on the turbine one compressor yesterday as well. Just making that distinction before filters come up.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, different one from the air compressor. Easy to muddle them when everyone's talking at once.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Exactly. The turbine one compressor job's finished.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll swap the filter on the air compressor this afternoon. It's urgent, that one.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Thanks, Tom. Air compressor, this afternoon, urgent. That's the live filter job.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do that one. Not repeating yesterday's work.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Good distinction. I was halfway through writing the wrong compressor there.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: While I'm on, I heard a slight rattle from the Main Water Isolation Valve. Nothing to action yet, just an observation.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, not a job being allocated off the back of that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, exactly. Just saying what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Same sort of thing from me: noticed the boiler was running a bit warm on nights, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Settled, yeah. Not saying we've got an ongoing temperature problem.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay, observation only. No extra boiler work from that.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: The actual blocker is the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the boiler feed pump. Still no confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no firm delivery date behind it. Nothing useful to put against it yet.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: So that remains blocked. I'm not calling it something we can get on with today.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Understood. Blocked, no new allocation.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Oh, and we were going to replace the belt on the line 2 guard, but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, that's out of today's work. Not a belt replacement for this stand-up.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right. Han, can you write up the near miss at the forklifts by Wednesday? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, I can't take that one. I haven't got the capacity to give the write-up the attention it needs, especially straight away.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay, handing that over, then. Jamie Brennan, can you write up the near miss at the forklifts by Wednesday? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it. I'll get straight onto the near miss at the forklifts and have the write-up done by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Thanks. The Wednesday deadline isn't a reason to leave it sitting; that's why I'm stressing the safety-critical bit.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Understood. Straight away, and it's mine now rather than Han's.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: For mine, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the GT2 water valve for Monday. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Priya, Monday for the risk assessment update, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, Monday. Fairly important, but I'm not putting it in the same urgent bracket as those first two.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And that's the assessment for the work, not us agreeing to do the physical valve work here?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Exactly. Just the risk assessment update for work on the GT2 water valve.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Han, separate one: can you take vibration readings on the gas turbine one by the 28th? Whenever you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, that window works. I'll take vibration readings on the gas turbine one by the 28th.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Gas turbine one itself, yeah? Not that compressor filter we were just talking about.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, gas turbine one. Readings, not a filter change. Whenever I get a chance within that deadline.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Spot on. No need to treat that as an urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Fiona, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team for tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yes, I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team for tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped there — tomorrow, not today?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Tomorrow, yeah. That's what I've accepted.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, quick check of the live actions, then we're out of your headphones.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Mine's the air compressor filter, this afternoon. Urgent. The rattle isn't a job, and the line 2 guard belt is deferred.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I've got the near miss at the forklifts write-up, by Wednesday, getting onto it straight away. Safety critical.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I've accepted the gas turbine one vibration readings by the 28th, whenever I get a chance. Not the near miss write-up.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Toolbox talk for the team, tomorrow, with me. Big boiler test is already finished.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I'll update the risk assessment for work on the GT2 water valve for Monday. Fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Nothing new with me out of this, then. Boiler feed pump delivery still blocked on supplier confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Correct. We're not turning that status update into another action.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Good. A stand-up that might actually finish before my tea goes cold.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No need to rub it in. Some of us have canteen disappointment.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Ha. Right, thanks all. That's us.
